scope: Exploratory structural-material qualification, not a scientific comparison or approved policy manifest

source_filters.heteroatom_count: N + O + S atoms, excluding halogens

cohorts.matching: Exact source heavy-atom count and RDKit ring count bins; outcome-blind SHA-256 structure ordering within each bin
cohorts.selection: Round-robin across sorted common bins until 20 matched pairs or no pair remains; require an even count and at least 8 per focused library
cohorts.mixed_reference: Equal-sized mixture, half selected from each focused cohort, using deterministic alternating matched-pair positions
cohorts.limitations: Source enrichment is a proxy; only actual context-replacement diagnostics can qualify the intended contrast. The mixed reference intentionally overlaps the focused source lists.

material_qualification.source: supplied v5 CReM legacy pipeline, exact inspected working files
compare: lead-applicable nonidentity replacement pairs under actual worker windows
shared and exclusive replacements at shared lead contexts
compact 2-6-heavy-atom single-attachment core composition stratified by size
material_qualification.meaningfulness: Both focused libraries need distinct eligible replacements in at least one shared reference context; intended fragment-level heteroatom contrast must be inspected and may fail. No thresholds will be adjusted using activity, QED or similarity outcomes.

reference: Public paper-derived DRD2 example lead, exact unspecified-stereo form; existing campaign state is untouched
approval: candidate_only; no authenticated SME review or execution authorization implied
interpretation: No change in target activity, QED, synthesizability or success probability is assumed. Equal source counts do not imply equal replacement opportunities or compute.
